title: The ticked rows are kept when the active tab's list is replaced by a search or a calendar jump
trigger: Tick rows in Files, type a search text (begin_search) or jump to a date (begin_fetch_at_day): only select_tab, open_for_tab and close clear selection
effect: The header still counts N selected and Forward/Delete selected act on rows that are no longer in the list
fix: Selection lives in the tab's ready stage and is dropped whenever the items are replaced

title: The Playlist page and the gallery are two Options kept in step by hand
trigger: playlist_user is set by the UI over an open gallery (chat_id stays Some), cleared by close_playlist_ui, open_for_tab and close; renderers and the Esc stack test both with precedence
effect: None today
fix: enum View{Closed, Gallery(chat), Playlist{user, under: Option<chat>}}

title: Dead duplicate SponsoredReport state machine beside the live SponsoredReportFlow
trigger: SponsoredReport (Idle, Chosen, Asking, Picking, Outcome) is used nowhere; messages.sponsored_report is SponsoredReportFlow. The unused Chosen stage has no sender and no way out
effect: Nothing today; a future caller picks the wrong enum
fix: Delete SponsoredReport (and SponsoredReportOutcome/Flight duplicates if unused)

title: The sticker batch is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed and batch_pending are set together in connect/stickers.rs and moved by finish_sticker_batch_item; total = completed + failed + pending.len() is not enforced and there is no idle or done stage
effect: None today; progress of a finished batch lingers until the next batch
fix: enum Batch{Idle, Running{pending: Vec<i64>, done: usize, failed: usize}}

title: Refetch marks recent_stale, favorites_stale, trending_stale and GifPanel::stale are bools beside Fetch fields that already have Outdated
trigger: refresh_stale_panels and maybe_refresh_saved_animations read and clear them; the section 8 entries 03-032 and 09-032 say trending_stale and GifPanel::stale are gone but both are still here
effect: None today beyond the lost-mark bug
fix: Fetch::Outdated on lists.recent/favorites/trending and saved

title: The Attached Stickers lookup is attached_request and attached_answer plus a loading sticker_set_view
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets resets the answer, sets request and a loading box; apply sets the answer and clears the request; open_attached_sticker_set takes the answer; error clears the request and fails the box
effect: None today
fix: enum Attached{Idle, Asking(RequestId), Answered(Option<i64>)}

title: GifSearch::request duplicates the request already held by fetch: Fetch::Loading
trigger: search_asked, search_sent, search_answered and search_failed_now set fetch and request separately; Fetch has sent() and waits_for()
effect: None today
fix: Drop request; use fetch.sent(request) and fetch.waits_for(request)

title: A GIF search's results, offsets and chat live outside its GifSearch stage and are reset by hand
trigger: search_gifs and the core upkeep clear search_results, search_next_offset and search_offset next to search_begun; search_begun and search_left do not
effect: None today; a caller that only calls search_begun shows the previous search's results
fix: Move results, next_offset and chat into GifSearch so a new search replaces them

title: A failed composer sticker suggestion leaves SuggestFor::Asked, so it is never asked again for that emoji
trigger: Type an emoji, the searchStickers (SuggestStickers) request errors; no error arm resets suggest_for, and update_sticker_suggestions returns early when the emoji equals the Asked emoji
effect: No sticker suggestions for that emoji until the trailing emoji changes; also the answer is accepted by purpose, not by request id
fix: Asked{emoji, request} with Failed; an error moves it to Failed and a retry on the next keystroke

title: StoryManageState keeps the same call as the slot request, in_flight and settled
trigger: start pushes to in_flight and sets the slot; settle updates both; forget_in_flight clears one; fail_locally clears only the slot
effect: None today
fix: Slot derived from the latest entry of one calls list

title: Page-in-flight staleness is a blacklist of request ids kept in step by hand with every window move
trigger: Any code path that replaces or trims a window end must remember to add the in-flight ids to TopicHistory::stale_pages or history_pruning.gone_topic_pages; ThreadView::reset_window duplicates TopicHistory::reset_window and forgot (see thread note_live bug)
effect: None today beyond the thread note_live bug; the sets also keep ids of requests that never answer
fix: OlderEnd/NewerEnd gain Loading{request}; a window move replaces the stage, so an answer for another request is dropped by comparison

title: Reported is a two-variant enum that is a bool for 'rows were reported'
trigger: Open a history, then scroll: restart() sets Unreported, report() sets Reported, restart_reported() sets it directly
effect: The book's phase is a flag beside the per-message stages that abort() and the newest-row rule branch on; it is changed from three methods, not from stage transitions
fix: Fold into the stage: ViewBook as enum { Newest(stages), Reported(stages, on_screen) } so on_screen only exists once reported

title: The logout stage is spread over AuthState::logout_request, AuthState::logout_refused and Session::shutdown
trigger: logOut is refused by TDLib while auth is not Ready, or a quit is requested meanwhile (auth/error.rs:22-32)
effect: None today; the refusal only resets shutdown when auth is Ready, so a refusal in another auth state clears logout_request but leaves shutdown at CloseRequested
fix: one LogoutStage { Idle, Requested(RequestId), Refused(TdError) } inside ShutdownPhase

title: A failed getUser for a group bot is never retried: asked_bot_users marks the bot as asked and bots/error.rs has no arm for GroupBotUser
trigger: Open a group whose bot_commands name a bot that is not cached while offline for that one request, or TDLib answers an error
effect: The bot is left out of the '/' menu of the group for the rest of the session (command_bot returns None so group_command_rows filters it)
fix: HashMap<bot id, Fetch<()>> where Failed is retried on the next open and the error arm settles it

title: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading has no RequestId; a failure removes the entry by bot id
trigger: Open a bot profile, close and reopen it so a second getBotSimilarBots goes out while the first is in flight, then the first fails
effect: The Loading entry of the second request is removed by the first's error and a stray answer can land on an entry that no longer waits
fix: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading(RequestId)

title: CallsState::call_link and call_link_stage are two fields for one call-link flow
trigger: A call link arrives while a call is on, the user leaves the call, the getGroupCall fails (error.rs:323-331 clears call_link only)
effect: None today; the stage can be Idle while call_link still holds a hash that a later join would send
fix: fold PendingCallLink into CallLinkStage variants

title: recent_calls, recent_calls_offset and recent_calls_stage are three fields for one paged list
trigger: Reopen the Calls tab after a failed page, or Clear all while a page is in flight
effect: None today; the offset has to be reset by hand with the list (the empty offset restarts it) so a reset that misses it appends a page to an old cursor
fix: Paged<ParsedMessage> with its PageStage (src/state/paged.rs)

title: Add-chat request pages are matched by community id and purpose, and Fetch::Loading is stored with request: None
trigger: Open the requests list, press Load more, then reopen (first page) while the older page is in flight
effect: A load-more answer that lands after the first page is appended to the new list and overwrites next_offset with the old cursor
fix: Fetch::Loading { request: Some(id) } and apply only the held request (connect/communities.rs:249)

title: ChatStatisticsFetch::Loading { is_dark } holds the theme but not the RequestId; the answer is filed by chat id and purpose
trigger: Open Statistics in light theme, switch to dark so refresh_chat_statistics asks again, the first answer lands second
effect: The charts are drawn with the older request's colors but recorded as the dark ones
fix: Loading { request: RequestId, is_dark } and take only that answer

title: chatInviteLinks answers for GetChatInviteLinks and GetRevokedChatInviteLinks are stored without the Loading(RequestId) check the admin pages use
trigger: Create or revoke a link while a getChatInviteLinks for the same chat is in flight
effect: The older list lands over the newer one and the panel shows the link that was just revoked
fix: apply only when the slot is Loading(pending.id), as GetAdminChatInviteLinks does (apply.rs:403)

title: chat_boost_status (level, count) and chat_boost_details hold the same answer in two maps, plus boost_level_moved as a refetch mark
trigger: getChatBoostStatus answer; updateSupergroup with a new boost_level
effect: None today; take_moved_boost_chats removes chat_boost_status but leaves chat_boost_details, and connect/groups/boosts.rs:12 drops a failed refetch (`let _`), so the details stay stale until the dialog is reopened
fix: one Fetch<BoostStatus> per chat that is marked Stale by the level change

title: Fetch errors for chat statistics, administrators, basic group members and admin rights are applied by chat id, not by the RequestId of the request that failed
trigger: A list is loaded, a refresh or membership update re-asks, the older request fails late (or a failed refresh while Loaded)
effect: GetChatStatistics, GetChatAdministrators, GetBasicGroupFullInfo and GetAdminRights errors insert Failed over a Loaded or newer Loading value (AdminListFetch/SupergroupMembersFetch/AdminRightsFetch/ChatStatisticsFetch::Loading hold no request id), so a good list is replaced by an error
fix: Move to Fetch<T> with request id (answered/failed) as invite_links and join_requests already do

title: PublicChatsFetch::Loading carries no RequestId; the getCreatedPublicChats answer and error are matched by purpose only
trigger: Open the public links limit box (Loading), free a link (revoke settle sets public_chats=None), reopen the box so a second list is asked while the first answer is still out
effect: The older answer lands as Loaded (or its error as Failed, apply_group_type_error writes Failed unconditionally) over the newer fetch, so the box lists stale chats or shows Failed while the newer request is in flight
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<ChatId>> with request id and answered/failed matching

title: CreationAsker{Dialog,Closed} is a two-variant enum beside NewChatCreation::outcome (None = in flight): the 'owner closed' flag of the create, and open_when_created/make_invite_link are bools copied from the kind
trigger: close the dialog while a create is out, or a create that is lost (request swept, never answered)
effect: a Closed create whose request is lost and never answered keeps its `creations` row for the session (abandon_new_chat only removes answered rows); the real stage (InFlight/Answered/Abandoned) is spread over asker and outcome
fix: enum CreationStage { InFlight{owner: Dialog|Closed}, Created(ChatId), Refused{..} } so abandoning is a transition and a lost request removes the row

title: CreationAsker Dialog/Closed is a two-variant flag beside NewChatStage::Creating (the real stage of the same create)
trigger: Open New Group, press Create, close the box while it is out, open another New Group
effect: Who may open/read the answer is held in the creation row (asker) while the dialog stage lives in NewChatStage; the two are kept in step by abandon_new_chat called from close/replace sites
fix: One value: the creation row exists only while the dialog owns it (Owned(request) vs Detached(request) as the stage's own variant), removed with the stage

title: sharing_request_answered treats any toggle service message right after the request as its answer
trigger: Two Enable Sharing requests in a chat; the first was answered by a ProtectedToggled for request A, the card of request B (older, expired) directly before it
effect: next_is_toggle only checks toggle_request_id(next).is_some(), it never compares with message_id, so an expired request card followed by any toggle keeps its Accept/Reject card instead of the expired line
fix: Compare the toggle's request_message_id with message_id for the next message too

title: invite_link_error and community_error are shared one-shot slots written by many purposes and overwritten by the next error
trigger: Two invite-link mutations fail before the UI poll drains the slot
effect: The first error line is lost; the slot is not tied to the request or box that caused it (also GroupsState::member_list_stale, add_members_failed)
fix: A queue of notices (like PaymentsState::notices) or the error carried in the owning box's Submit stage

title: Pinned messages, poll voters and poll statistics answers and errors are applied by chat/message key, not by the RequestId held in the Fetch
trigger: Open a chat (GetPinnedMessages out), pull to the next channel and back so a second fetch is out; or open a poll's statistics twice
effect: GetPinnedMessages error calls Fetch::fail (not failed(id)) and PollVoteStatistics/PollVoters answers insert Loaded/Failed over a newer Loading, so an older answer or error replaces the newer fetch
fix: Fetch::answered/failed with the request id; PollStatsFetch/PollVotersFetch carry the request in Loading
